'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] reportedly retake the village of [[Staromaiorske]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-27-23/h_9b3c769c047d88d03465bff4972f0b9e (CNN International)]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**Supporters of the [[coup d'état|military coup]] against [[List of heads of state of Niger|President]] [[Mohamed Bazoum]] [[arson|set fire]] to the [[headquarters]] of the ruling [[Nigerien Party for Democracy and Socialism]] in [[Niamey]], [[Niger]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-66324875 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Six people are killed and 20 others are injured during a bombing at the [[Sayyidah Zaynab]]'s [[Sayyidah Zainab Mosque, Damascus|Shi'ite mosque]] in [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/syria-blast-kills-six-ahead-of-ashura-101690493286161.html (AFP via ''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The government of [[Rome]], [[Italy]], announces the [[Classical archaeology|discovery]] of [[Roman emperor]] [[Nero]]'s [[Theatre of Nero|private theatre]] under the courtyard of the [[Palazzo Della Rovere]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/emperor-nero-theater-rome-scn-scli-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 27 people are killed and six others are missing when a boat [[capsizes]] in [[Laguna de Bay]] off the coast of [[Binangonan]], [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-ferry-accident-a4324728a3f0695492cc58cebb1c2dc4 (AP)]
*One person is killed and 84 others are injured by a [[chlorine]] gas leakage at a [[sewage plant]] in [[Qena]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.egyptindependent.com/chlorine-gas-leakage-in-qena-kills-one-worker-injures-84/ (''Egypt Independent'')]
*An evacuation is ordered due to an explosion of an ammunition dump of [[Hellenic Air Force|an air force base]] in [[Nea Anchialos]], [[Magnesia (regional unit)|Magnesia]], [[Greece]], due to the [[2023 Greece wildfires|ongoing wildfires]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/greece-evacuations-ordered-after-blast-in-ammo-warehouse/a-66371232 (DW News)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Climate change]]
**[[United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] declares that Earth has entered an "age of global boiling" as scientists confirm that [[2023 heat waves|this year's heat waves]] have been some of the [[List of weather records|hottest in recorded history]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2023/jul/27/scientists-july-world-hottest-month-record-climate-temperatures (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–North Korea relations]], [[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[North Korea]]n [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|Supreme Leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]], [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian defence minister]] [[Sergei Shoigu]] and a Chinese delegation meet in [[Pyongyang]] to celebrate the 70th anniversary of the cessation of hostilities during the [[Korean War]]. Kim and Shoigu also attend an exhibition of North Korean [[ballistic missile]]s, which have been prohibited by [[List of United Nations Security Council resolutions concerning North Korea|multiple United Nations resolutions]] endorsed by [[China]] and [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/north-koreas-kim-jong-un-meets-russian-defence-minister-2023-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Papua New Guinea–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of Defense|United States Defense Secretary]] [[Lloyd Austin]] announces the deployment of a [[United States Coast Guard Cutter|Coast Guard Cutter]] to [[Papua New Guinea]] in August. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/28/world/asia-oceania/us-to-deploy-ship-to-papua-new-guinea/1902796 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Kuwait]]
**[[Kuwait]] [[executes]] five men, including one involved in the [[2015 Kuwait mosque bombing|suicide bombing of a mosque in 2015]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/kuwait-executes-5-prisoners-including-man-convicted-2015-101709062 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[USA Gymnastics sex abuse scandal]]
**A lawsuit is filed against [[Michigan State University]] in [[Michigan]], [[United States|U.S.]], accusing the school of "illegal secret votes" to prevent the release of 6,000 documents in the case of an investigation involving [[Larry Nassar]], who was sentenced to 40 to 175 years in prison in 2018. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/larry-nassar-survivors-sue-michigan-state-saying-it-made-secret-decisions-about-releasing-documents (''PBS NewsHour'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[China–India relations]]
**The [[government of India]] withdraws the [[India]]n [[Wushu (sport)|Wushu]] team from the [[2021 Summer World University Games|Summer World University Games]] in [[Chengdu]], [[China]], in order to protest against the issuance of Chinese [[Visa policy of mainland China|stapled visa]]s to three of the athletes who are from the [[Indian state|state]] of [[Arunachal Pradesh]], as the issuance of such [[travel visa|visas]] is seen as an attempt by China to assert territorial claim over the state. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/india-reacts-to-china-issuing-stapled-visa-to-arunachal-players-2412649-2023-07-27 (''India Today'')]
